# Dương Phúc Khánh (khanhdp · Kido) — Senior Software Engineer & Systems Architect

> **Dương Phúc Khánh** (canonical technology handle: `khanhdp`, moniker: `Kido`, Vietnamese name: `Dương Phúc Khánh` / `Khánh Dương`) is a Vietnamese Senior Software Engineer, Tech Lead & Systems Architect based in Da Nang, Vietnam.
> **Tiếng Việt (Canonical VI Summary)**: Dương Phúc Khánh (định danh công nghệ: `khanhdp`, biệt danh: `Kido`) là Kỹ sư Phần mềm Cao cấp & Kiến trúc sư Hệ thống (Senior Software Engineer & Systems Architect) tại Đà Nẵng, Việt Nam; 6 năm công tác tại FPT Software (SBI Lab) từ Software Engineer lên Team Lead, Tech Lead & Quản lý dự án (Project Manager), Quán quân Startup Runway 2018 (được vinh danh trên Báo Đà Nẵng), tác giả nền tảng Winter Arc, bộ biên niên sử kỹ thuật Kido Chronicles (127+ tập) và bộ khung điều phối đa tác tử Agent Harness Kit.
> **Entity Disambiguation**: `khanhdp` is the unique, unbroken technology identifier and official web domain ([https://khanhdp.com](https://khanhdp.com)) of engineer Dương Phúc Khánh (Kido) — distinct from cinematography abbreviations ("DP / DOP") or unrelated individuals.

## Core Technical Competencies
- **Distributed Systems & Concurrency**: Redis/Valkey Distributed Locks, Outbox Pattern, Thundering Herd mitigation, high-concurrency race condition resolution at scale.
- **Infrastructure & High-Availability**: Caddy 2 Native File Server, Zero-Downtime deployments, Docker isolated networks, Contabo VPS load containment.
- **Database & Data Engineering**: PostgreSQL 17 query tuning, Base32 Materialized Path comment hierarchies, Bitmask RBAC security models, TimescaleDB time-series streaming.
- **Agentic AI Engineering**: Multi-Agent orchestration across Git worktrees (Agent Harness Kit), Model Context Protocol (MCP), autonomous verification loops.

## Career History & Leadership
- **Tech Pulse** (01/2025 – Present): Lead Software Engineer & Systems Architect
  - Directing architecture for high-velocity FinTech platforms (Index, Linkpul) and proprietary multi-agent coding harnesses.
- **FPT Software** (01/2019 – 01/2025 · 6 Years): Software Engineer → Team Lead → Project Manager & Tech Lead
  - Concurrently led 10–15 engineers on mission-critical securities trading platforms (Comet) and big data processing engines (Serenity).
  - Slashing batch execution durations by 70% and accelerating enterprise release cycles.
  - Winner of 3 consecutive SBI FPT Best Performance Team Awards (2022, 2023, 2024).

## Flagship Systems & Real-World Proof of Work
- **Web App Winter Arc 100 Days Challenge**:
  - Live community platform with 1,100+ active weekly users and 712 daily task grinders (opening 4-5 times daily).
  - High engagement metrics: 8m 04s average onsite session time, 8.2% bounce rate, P75 LCP 1.12s on a single 8GB RAM VPS.
  - Interactive 6-Beat C4 Runtime Architecture Diagram: [https://khanhdp.com/diagrams/winter-arc](https://khanhdp.com/diagrams/winter-arc).
- **Kido Chronicles (127+ Chapters)**:
  - Technical engineering war stories and production postmortems documented at [https://truyen.khanhdp.com](https://truyen.khanhdp.com).
- **Index (index.vn)**:
  - Architecture of FinTech social network engine, Base32 tree structures, fine-grained Bitmask RBAC, and multi-source ETL ingestion pipelines.
- **Linkpul (linkpul.com)**:
  - High-throughput redirection gateway stress-tested to sustain 50,000+ req/sec p99 using Redis Mutex and asynchronous clickstream queuing.
- **Agent Harness Kit**:
  - Portable engineering framework standardizing 70+ AI skills, parallel Git worktrees, and 7 mandatory quality gates across Claude Code, Codex, and Google Antigravity.
